title: 第13章 第二宿敌录震惊石矶第14章 乘风赴蓬莱小友且留步
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
李玄霄取出古镜，其上浮现的文字让李玄霄嘴角上扬三分。
【百年结算开始！】
【结算事件一：血岭得利！鹬蚌相争渔翁在后，以直报怨，以德报德，夺马元机缘，得魔猿遗宝。评级：凡品中！】
【得机缘：后天灵宝-青霄藏宝袋。藏宝之物，可纳虚藏物，灵性不失，本源不损；可风雷困敌，风索其身，雷镇其神。】
【结算事件二：结仇长耳！今日因，他日果，种恶因，自得恶果，结仇长耳定光仙。评级：凡品中！】
【得机缘：宿敌录-长耳定光仙页。既结因，当有果，可感应长耳定光仙当前位置、状态，并在其遇机缘、遭劫难之时有所预示。】
【结算事件三：端坐蒲团！金鳌岛上，陋室之中，端坐蒲团，苦心修炼，入真仙之境界。评级：凡品中！】
【得机缘：后天灵果-十万年朱果。千年开花，千年结果，又经十万年寒暑吸纳天地灵气，内含纯阳之气、日月之精，吞服炼化，可大增修为。】
【百年结算完成，待领取机缘：后天灵宝-青霄藏宝袋、宿敌录-长耳定光仙页、后天灵果-十万年朱果！】
来了！来了！来了！
李玄霄第一眼看到的便是这宿敌录-长耳定光仙页！
“长耳定光仙！”
李玄霄眼中闪烁精芒，心中想着日后夺其机缘之时，那长耳该是个什么表情。
随后李玄霄看向了另外两样东西。
后天灵宝青霄藏宝袋。
此宝乃是上品后天灵宝，这对于现在的李玄霄而言，可谓是瞌睡了就来枕头。
此前自己还为没有合适的储物灵宝烦恼，现在便有了这般灵宝。
这青霄藏宝袋仅巴掌大小，通体呈淡青金二色，袋身绣着极简的风雷道纹，不催发时灵韵完全内敛，看着就像个普通的绣袋，毫不起眼。
其功能主要有二，其一纳虚藏物，袋内自成一方近千丈的储物空间，时间流速近乎停滞，可保灵药不泄药性、灵材不失本源，更能完美隔绝所有灵宝灵光、气息波动，哪怕是先天灵物放在里面，也不会外泄半分气机。
日常可缩成芥子大小藏于元神内温养，随身携带，万无一失。

其二它还有困敌之用。
当祭出后，以灵力催动，迎风便涨，可大可小，最大可化作数十丈大小，青风金雷从袋口翻涌而出，先天风雷道韵铺展开来，袋口似化作无底深渊，带着极强的吞噬拉扯之力。
对方一旦被吸入袋内，瞬间便会被先天巽风锁住肉身、先天惊雷镇压元神。
此后九重风雷禁制层层叠加。
哪怕是修为比自己高的修士，猝不及防之下也可能被兜入袋中，困于其内难以脱身。
“不错，不错！”
看着手中的青霄藏宝袋，李玄霄不住的点头。
随后祭出青霄藏宝袋，将那些堆积的元晶、天材地宝等等都收入袋中，又将藏宝袋在识海内蕴养。
最后的机缘便是这颗十万年朱果!
其果皮如最剔透的赤霞琉璃，表面天然生着九条道纹，纹路间萦绕着肉眼可见的灵气，放在手心，已然能感受到这股温润却磅礴的精纯灵力！
李玄霄指尖摩挲着这十万年朱果，眸中先是闪过一丝悸动，随即又微微顿住，心中念头百转。
content_en:
Li Xuanxiao took out the ancient mirror, and the words that appeared on it made Li Xuanxiao raise the corners of his mouth.
[The centenary settlement begins! 】
[Settlement event one: Blood Ridge wins! The snipe and the clam compete with each other, and the fisherman is behind him. He repays his grievances with straightness and repays kindness with kindness. He seizes the opportunity of horse yuan and obtains the treasure left by the devil ape. Rating: Out of the ordinary! 】
[Opportunity: Acquired Lingbao - Qingxiao Treasure Bag. Hidden treasures can contain empty treasures without losing their spirituality and originality; they can be trapped by wind and thunder, the wind can tie up their body, and the thunder can suppress their spirit. 】
[Settlement Event 2: Enemy Long Ear! Today's cause will be tomorrow's result. If you sow evil causes, you will reap evil consequences. Rating: Out of the ordinary! 】
[Opportunity: Record of Old Enemies-Long-ear Dingguang Immortal Page. Once the cause is established, there will be an effect. It can sense the current position and status of the Long-ear Dingguang Immortal, and predict when it encounters opportunities or disasters. 】
[Settlement event three: Sitting on the futon! On Jin'ao Island, in a humble room, he was sitting on a futon, practicing hard and entering the realm of a true immortal. Rating: Out of the ordinary! 】
[Opportunity: Acquired Spiritual Fruit - Hundred Thousand Years Red Fruit. It blooms for thousands of years and bears fruit for thousands of years. After hundreds of thousands of years of cold and heat, it absorbs the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. It contains pure Yang energy and the essence of the sun and moon. If you swallow it and refine it, you can greatly increase your cultivation. 】
[The centenary settlement is completed, and the opportunity to receive it is waiting for: the acquired spiritual treasure - Qingxiao treasure bag, the enemy record - the long-eared light fairy page, the acquired spiritual fruit - the hundred thousand year red fruit! 】
Coming! Coming! Coming!
The first thing Li Xuanxiao saw was this record of old enemies - the Long-Eared Dingguang Immortal Page!
"Long-eared Dingguang Immortal!"
Li Xuanxiao's eyes flashed, thinking about what that long-eared expression would look like when he gets the chance in the future.
Then Li Xuanxiao looked at two other things.
The acquired treasure Qingxiao treasure bag.
This treasure is a top-grade acquired spiritual treasure. For Li Xuanxiao now, it can be said that he comes to pillow when he is sleepy.
Before, I was worried about not having a suitable storage treasure, but now I have such a treasure.
This Qingxiao treasure bag is only about the size of a palm, and is in light green and gold. The body of the bag is embroidered with minimalist wind and thunder patterns. When not activated, the aura is completely restrained. It looks like an ordinary embroidered bag, unremarkable.
It has two main functions. The first is to hold hidden objects. The bag has a storage space of nearly a thousand feet. The flow of time is almost stagnant. It can ensure that the elixir does not leak out its medicinal properties and the spiritual materials do not lose their origin. It can also perfectly isolate all the spiritual light and breath fluctuations of the spiritual treasures. Even if the innate spiritual objects are placed in it, half of the air will not leak out.
On a daily basis, it can be shrunk into the size of a mustard seed and stored in the Yuanshen for warmth and nourishment. It can be carried around with you and is foolproof.
Secondly, it can also be used to trap enemies.
After it is sacrificed, it is driven by spiritual power and swells in the wind. It can be large or small, and the maximum can be tens of feet in size. Green wind and golden thunder surge out from the mouth of the bag, and the innate wind and thunder rhyme spreads out. The mouth of the bag seems to turn into a bottomless abyss, with extremely strong swallowing and pulling power.
Once the opponent is sucked into the bag, his body will be locked by the innate Xun wind and his soul will be suppressed by the innate thunder.
Since then, nine levels of wind and thunder restrictions have been layered on top of each other.
Even a monk with a higher level of cultivation than himself may be caught off guard and trapped in the bag, making it difficult to escape.
"Not bad, not bad!"
Looking at the Qingxiao treasure bag in his hand, Li Xuanxiao couldn't help but nod.
Then he took out the Qingxiao treasure bag, put all the accumulated Yuan crystals, heavenly materials, earthly treasures, etc. into the bag, and then stored the treasure bag in the sea of ​​consciousness.
The last chance is this hundred thousand year old red fruit!
Its skin is like the clearest red rosy glaze, with nine lines naturally appearing on the surface. There is spiritual energy visible to the naked eye lingering among the lines. Putting it in the palm of your hand, you can already feel this warm but majestic pure spiritual power!
Li Xuanxiao rubbed the hundred-thousand-year-old red fruit with his fingertips. A flash of fear first flashed in his eyes, and then he paused slightly, with thoughts running through his mind.
